headline: KLA Corporation Cratered 40% Over The Last 30 Days: The Next 12 Months Will Bring 75% Returns According to One Wall Street Pro
summary: KLA Corporation just cratered 40% from its highs despite beating earnings five quarters in a row, leaving Wall Street torn between a China-risk nightmare and a structural AI story that one analyst thinks is worth 78% more than today's price.
